To turn long YouTube videos into viral Shorts and Reels, identify high-retention 30-to-60 second clips, reframe the aspect ratio from 16:9 to vertical 9:16 with active speaker centering, and overlay dynamic captions. Using an integrated platform like IncuBrix Creator Studio automates the extraction, subtitle generation, and multi-platform publishing directly from a single screen.

## Why Video Repurposing is the #1 Growth Lever in 2026

Long-form YouTube videos and podcasts require tremendous research and production energy. However, over 70% of modern content discovery happens on algorithmic vertical feeds including TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Repurposing allows creators to maximize ROI on every single hour spent recording.

### The Math Behind Content Multiplication
- 1 Long-form episode (45 minutes)
- Generates 8 to 12 distinct high-impact hooks
- Multiplied across 4 platforms (Shorts, Reels, TikTok, LinkedIn)
- Yields up to 48 touchpoints per week

## Step-by-Step Guide to Repurposing Videos

### 1. Identify Hook-Driven Moments
Scan your transcript for provocative questions, counter-intuitive data, or emotional declarations within the first 3 seconds of each segment.

### 2. Auto-Reframe with Dynamic Speaker Tracking
Switching from landscape 16:9 to vertical 9:16 requires active face tracking so speakers do not get cropped out when gesturing or moving across the frame.

### 3. Generate Word-Level Synchronized Subtitles
Over 80% of mobile users watch vertical video on silent. Clear, styled subtitles with bold animations increase retention by up to 38%.

### 4. Cross-Publish Without Leaving Your Dashboard
Instead of rendering files to your desktop and manually uploading to three mobile apps, use IncuBrix Creator Studio to schedule and publish across platforms simultaneously.

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the optimal length for viral short clips?
Between 30 to 45 seconds generally offers the highest completion rate across modern platforms.

# AEO & GEO Glossary: The Language of AI Search

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) are practices designed to ensure your brand, products, and content are accurately understood, cited, and recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Perplexity. Key concepts include brand citation share, entity linking, direct-answer structuring, and llms.txt integration.

## Core Definitions

### 1. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
The discipline of tailoring website architecture, schema markup, and content citations so synthetic AI models retrieve your brand during conversational queries.

### 2. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
Formatting answers in concise, two-sentence definitions directly matching user intent for featured snippets and AI overviews.

### 3. llms.txt
A standardized markdown file placed in a website root directory providing clean, concise documentation for LLM scrapers.

markdown_content:
# Why llms.txt is the Secret Weapon for AI Search Visibility

The llms.txt file is a markdown file placed at the root of a domain that provides concise, structured information for Large Language Model crawlers like ChatGPT and Perplexity. By implementing a clean llms.txt, brands help AI models understand their core value propositions, feature sets, and pricing without hallucinating incorrect details.

## How AI Bots Read Your Website
Standard web crawlers parse HTML and CSS to index keyword tokens. In contrast, LLM answer engines synthesize contextual relationships. High DOM complexity or heavy JavaScript client rendering often causes AI scrapers to drop key product facts.

## llms.txt Best Practices
1. Provide a direct 1-sentence company summary.
2. Clearly list core product capabilities and pricing tiers.
3. Link to documentation and verified resources.
